blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senator Mark Villar is pushing for a measure that seeks to grant tax credits to establishments granting mandatory discounts to senior citizens and persons with disabilities (PWDs), promoting a fairer tax system while ensuring the continued delivery of benefits to these sectors. Under Senate Bill No. 2494, or the proposed “Tax Credit for Senior Citizens and Persons with Disability Discount Act,” Villar seeks to amend Republic Act No. 9994, or the Expanded Senior Citizens Act of 2010, and Republic Act No. 7277, or the Magna Carta for Persons with Disability.
